method: Expected strings independently written from original instruction operands and reviewed against original loop bounds, substitutions, constant 255 insertions, IntToHex width and string-concatenation order; no production converter invoked to produce expected results.

algorithm_only_examples_outside_admitted.name: original_indicator_unlisted_values_are_unchanged

preservation_obligations: PP SET enumeration retains target agent constructor order, distinct from the IndicatorFunction-then-GroupAddress algorithm assignment order.

Fresh target LearnedFlag and LearnedFlagOriginal model values are both false before target PP hydration. LearnedFlag becomes immutable; a later target PP value must not be substituted for that fresh-model decision.
Target IRBank has no same-named classic source attribute because the constructor renamed InfraRedBank. The InfraRedBank tweaker lookup cannot clear an absent attribute's flag.

Target-only NightlightColour is initially mutable and is not explicitly suppressed by these tweaker or hook routines; same-name alignment, available PP values and changed-value checks still govern whether a write exists.
Suppressed target values retain their target baseline; copying a differently named or unsupported classic PP field would violate the original attribute graph.
Unchanged source or target fields, metadata and unknown PP entries must retain their established conversion-workflow preservation rules.
profile_refusal_examples: source firmware other than the admitted 1.2.67 lifecycle
target firmware other than the admitted 2.5.00 lifecycle
reused target model or editor-learned-state history
unregistered source/target pair even when both names appear elsewhere in this family
the five coupler/DINAUX4 KeyToNeo registrations and every NeoToKey direction
missing or wrong-shaped admitted source GroupAddress or IndicatorFunction strings
source group tokens outside 0..255 or indicator tokens outside 0..3
